customer_name: Shanghai International Automobile City (上海国际汽车城)
business_problem: Shanghai International Automobile City needed a secure, scalable way to label high-volume autonomous-driving data with complex 2D and 3D rules while protecting sensitive data and ensuring high-quality delivery for algorithm training.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud Data Crowdsourcing delivered a two-part model for Shanghai International Automobile City: a private annotation platform tailored to autonomous-driving scenarios and a dedicated labeling-base team for secure execution. The platform supports 2D, 3D, continuous-frame, and sensor-fusion annotation workflows, while AI pre-annotation and automated quality-inspection algorithms reduce the amount of purely manual labeling. Management features for tasks, data, and annotators give the customer centralized oversight, and private deployment keeps data inside the customer's controlled environment. To scale execution, Baidu paired the platform with a dedicated Shanxi labeling base of more than two thousand trained annotators operating under strict security controls such as non-disclosure agreements, sealed rooms, real-time video monitoring, and blocked USB ports. Together, the platform and the base-team model let Automobile City convert raw autonomous-driving data into high-quality training assets more quickly without giving up security or operational control.

solution_components.name: Private Annotation Platform
solution_components.role: Hosts customized autonomous-driving labeling workflows inside the customer's controlled environment.

solution_components.name: AI Pre-annotation
solution_components.role: Generates initial labels for complex 2D, 3D, continuous-frame, and fusion scenarios to cut manual effort.

solution_components.name: Automated Quality Inspection
solution_components.role: Checks label quality and helps the customer manage large annotation programs at scale.

solution_components.name: Dedicated Labeling Base Team
solution_components.role: Provides a trained secure workforce to execute high-volume autonomous-driving labeling under strict data controls.

data_flow: Autonomous-driving images and sequences enter the private annotation platform, where AI pre-annotation creates draft labels for 2D, 3D, continuous-frame, and fusion tasks. The dedicated team reviews and corrects those labels under secure controls, automated quality checks validate the output, and the final labeled datasets are delivered back to the customer's algorithm and evaluation workflows.
business_outcome: Automobile City increased annotation throughput, kept sensitive autonomous-driving data under tighter control, and gained a repeatable platform-plus-workforce model for supplying high-quality training data to intelligent-driving programs.
